ourStory.title: Our Story
ourStory.p1: Nestled in the rolling hills of Maramureș — one of Europe's last truly unspoiled regions — Belvedere was born from a love for this land and its timeless traditions.
ourStory.p2: Every detail, from the hand-carved wooden balconies to the locally sourced breakfast, reflects the soul of Maramureș.

about.heroSubtitle: Our story, our location and everything we offer
about.storyP1: Maramureș Belvedere is located on a hilltop at the entrance to Petrova from Sighetu Marmației, near the Dealul Hera forest.
about.storyP2: Access is easy — just 100 m off DN 18, the road connecting Sighetu Marmației and Vișeu.
about.storyP3: The nearest neighbors are 500–700 m away, making the guesthouse a perfect retreat from city bustle.
about.facilitiesSubtitle: Everything we've prepared to make your stay as pleasant as possible
about.kidsP1: We welcome children of all ages. Children up to 6 years old sleeping in their parents' bed stay for free.
about.kidsP2: Children between 6 and 13 years old (inclusive) stay at a rate of 50 RON/night.
about.jacuzziDesc: Hot tub with jacuzzi system and ambient lighting. Can be reserved for an extra fee for a relaxing experience under the open sky.
about.bikesDesc: 8 bicycles available free of charge for guests. Explore the surrounding trails at your own pace.
about.pingPongDesc: Ping pong table available free of charge for fun and relaxation outdoors.
about.sledsDesc: Free sleds for guests and a sledding hill right in the guesthouse yard — guaranteed fun in winter.
about.grillDesc: Outdoor area equipped for grilling and cooking in a cauldron. Enjoy a traditional meal in nature.
about.parkingDesc: Free private parking available for all guesthouse guests.
about.playgroundDesc: Playground with trampoline, swing and slide. Kids will have a wonderful time!
about.traditionalDesc: Opportunity to wear the traditional costume specific to Historic Maramureș — a unique cultural experience.
